meta.title: Features — Sunnsteel
meta.description: Everything Sunnsteel does to plan, log, measure and reward your training, with what's free and what's Pro.

featuresIndex.heading: Everything Sunnsteel does
featuresIndex.subline: Plan your routine, train with less to think about, read your progress in numbers and earn your rank. Here is all of it, and what each part costs.

cards.routineBuilder: Weekly or rotating routines, templates, versions and supersets, with a summary of what each week adds up to.
cards.progression: Weights that move from what you actually lift, and 8-week blocks with Pro.
cards.workoutTracker: Last time beside every set, rest that starts itself, plates and warm-ups worked out.
cards.progress: Strength, the body map, records and body weight, with signals and reviews on Pro.
cards.ranks: {ranks} ranks and {milestones} milestones earned by training, and records found in your sets.
cards.community: Follows, training partners and messages, with each part of your profile shown to whom you choose.

glance.heading: At a glance
glance.caption: Every capability, by what it helps you do, and whether it's in Free or Pro.

featuresIndex.pricingLine: Training itself is free. Pro adds planning depth, longer history and the AI tools. <link>See pricing</link>

free.a: Everything you do in a workout, your history, records, ranks and everything social. Pro adds planning depth, longer history and the AI tools.

install.q: Do I need an app store?
install.a: No. It runs in your browser and installs from it on any phone. <link>How to install</link>

data.a: Yes. Download everything as one file whenever you want, and delete your account completely at any time.

pricing.heading: Free to train. Pro to plan further.
pricing.subline: Everything you do in a workout is free. Pro adds planning depth, longer history and the AI tools.

free.heading: Is it free?
free.body: Yes: logging, progression, history, records, ranks and everything social are free, with no card.

compare.heading: Free and Pro, row by row

who.heading: Who Pro is for
who.planners: Lifters who plan blocks and deloads, and want each block's loads set in advance.
who.readers: Lifters who read their training closely: long history, comparisons and signals.
who.ai: Anyone who wants a routine drafted from a description, or a review of their own workouts.
